comment: Settings of the unofficial Windows test build, read by .github/scripts/release-package.mjs. minOfficialVersion is the official OpenTune release that must be installed on the machine (it provides the models and D3D12Core.dll); the side-car smoke test of prerelease.yml installs this version too (olderInstallers in .github/e2e/official-install.json), unpacks the package next to it and runs it, so a version that no longer works fails the build.
